comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: Does anyone have more information on this skill?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Being accessible from "Others-(2)" on the front page means that this skill is tied to Ornament effects when displayed in your Rank 5 Quarters' ornament gallery.

Others more learned than I can explain it, but essentially you can collect and display different ornaments with this effect and it will grant you a greater chance of resisting headaches based on the Rank you end up with. Cheers.

comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: Thank you, Guilder. Your information is very helpful.

comments.body: This skill is to allow you to read Archives longer than usual depending on the rank.
